data.description: Corner Unit | Private Pool | Renovated | Furnished
data.long_description:
Situated in the highly sought-after The Springs, this beautifully renovated villa offers modern finishes, spacious interiors, and a private swimming pool, creating the perfect family home in a peaceful gated community.

The property features a bright living and dining area, upgraded kitchen and bathrooms, and well-sized bedrooms with built-in wardrobes. The outdoor area includes a private pool and outhouse, ideal for relaxing or entertaining.
